jobs: The tiger begins to lose strength: neck lowers slightly, ears relax, front elbows flex while all four paws still support it. Shoulder about 40 source pixels lower than the standing reference. Tail curl starts to loosen. Eyes half closed.

Front knees buckle more deeply. Head and shoulders descend about 150 source pixels, muzzle points slightly downward. Both front paws still contact ground y1049, hind hips crouch modestly, rear paws remain planted. Tail lower and loose.

Both front knees bent fully, elbows near ground. Chest halfway lowered, muzzle low but not yet touching ground. Hind legs visibly crouch to lower the hip. All four limbs attached in the same near/far identities. Tail droops in a compact curl.

Chest and front elbows touch ground; hindquarters lose support and sink. Chin nearly touches ground at y1030. Hind legs fold beneath the flank. Body remains right facing with its torso lowered, not a normal standing crouch. Tail now rests in a low loose curl behind the hip.

The tiger tips onto its visible near/right flank. Shoulder and side of belly touch ground y1049. Front legs fold forward and sideways rather than support body, rear legs fold beside the body. Head rolls low onto cheek with eyes closed. Tail lies in a compact low curve beside the hip. Anatomical body lengths unchanged.

Fully lying on its near/right side. Entire side of shoulder, belly and hip resting on ground y1049. Head and cheek rest down on ground, eyes closed, mouth closed. Both front legs folded loosely ahead, both hind legs folded beside the hip. Tail rests low in a loose compact curl. No kneeling or raised chest.

Remain fully lying on the same flank, no upward motion. Chest settles fractionally lower, cheek remains touching ground. Four relaxed legs maintain the same attachments and folds. Tail curl relaxes subtly lower; body and head do not change size.

Remain fully side-prone with cheek on ground and eyes closed. Tiny final settling of shoulder fur and front paw; tail stays low behind hip. Nothing rises or stands. Maintain the same exact overall side-prone shape as previous frame.

Almost motionless fully side-prone corpse. Cheek and torso touch ground, eyes closed. Only tail tip relaxes a small amount closer to the hip while retaining compact width. All four resting legs remain visible and correctly attached.

Final still fully side-prone corpse. Head, cheek, shoulder, belly and hip resting on ground. Closed eyes, relaxed limbs folded in place. Compact tail lies down beside hip. Never return to crouching, sitting or standing. Same anatomy and pixel scale as prior prone frame.
